name: Leaderboard
description: A ranked leaderboard for sales teams, fundraisers, step challenges or game nights: a gold, silver and bronze podium for the top three and animated bars for everyone else. Type the scores in or connect a Google Sheet and let the board keep itself up to date.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: period
params.label: Period label
params.help: A short label beside the title, like "This month" or "Q3". Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: entries
params.label: Scores
params.help: One per line: Name | Score | Subtitle. The order doesn't matter, the board sorts it. Used when no data source is connected.
params.default:
Maya Okafor | 48,250 | Enterprise
Liam Chen | 41,900 | Mid-market

params.name: scores
params.label: Scores data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV, REST list or Manual table. When it has the Name and Score columns it replaces the scores typed above.

params.name: sub_col
params.label: Subtitle column
params.help: Optional. A second line under each name, like a team or a region.

params.name: score_prefix
params.label: Score prefix
params.help: Shown before every score, for example $ or €. Leave empty for plain numbers.

params.name: score_suffix
params.label: Score suffix
params.help: Shown after every score, for example pts, km or %.

params.name: max_rows
params.label: Show at most
params.help: Places shown, including the podium. The board shows fewer if the screen is too small for them all.

params.name: show_bars
params.label: Show bars
params.help: A bar under each name below the podium, as long as the score is close to the leader's.
